description: Thermostat Fleet DynamoDB Monte Carlo simulation — phase-3 capstone demo

panels.description: Thermostat Fleet demo overview and batch context.

options.content:
# Thermostat Fleet Demo

Monte Carlo simulation of an IoT thermostat fleet on DynamoDB.

Models: on-demand throttling, hot partitions, burst capacity, GSI write amplification, and LSI item-collection limits. Multi-region batches additionally model global-table replication with cross-region transfer costs.

- Batch ID: `${batch_id}`
- Scenario ID: `${scenarioId}`
- Trial Count: `${trialCount}`
- Simulation Ticks: `${simulationTicks}`
- Window Size (s): `${windowSizeSeconds}`

panels.description: Windowed ReadCapacityUnits percentile bands across trials.

targets.rawSql:
with percentiles as (
  select
    window_start_tick,
    avg("value") as mean,
    percentile_cont(0.05) within group (order by "value") as p5,
    percentile_cont(0.25) within group (order by "value") as p25,
    percentile_cont(0.75) within group (order by "value") as p75,
    percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by "value") as p95
  from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
  where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
    and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
    and metric = 'ReadCapacityUnits'
    and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  group by window_start_tick
)
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  mean as "Mean",
  p95 as "P95",
  p75 as "P75",
  p25 as "P25",
  p5 as "P5",
  p95 as "Band P95-P75",
  p75 as "Band P75-P25",
  p25 as "Band P25-P5"
from percentiles
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Total Write Capacity Units by Window

panels.description: Per-region WCU consumption per window (mean across trials). Multi-region only.

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:us-east-1:WriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "us-east-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:eu-west-1:WriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "eu-west-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:ap-southeast-1:WriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "ap-southeast-1"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric in ('Region:us-east-1:WriteCapacityUnits', 'Region:eu-west-1:WriteCapacityUnits', 'Region:ap-southeast-1:WriteCapacityUnits')
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick order by window_start_tick;

panels.description: Replicated write capacity units (rWCU) consumed per region per window. rWCU represents inbound replicated writes from other regions and bills at a lower rate than client-originated WCU (~22% cheaper in us-east-1).

select to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:us-east-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "us-east-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:eu-west-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "eu-west-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:ap-southeast-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "ap-southeast-1"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric in (
    'Region:us-east-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits',
    'Region:eu-west-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits',
    'Region:ap-southeast-1:ReplicatedWriteCapacityUnits'
  )
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick order by window_start_tick;

panels.description: Total cross-region data transfer bytes over the simulation (multi-region only). One bar per directional region pair.

panels.description: Mean items returned to callers per windowed period, split by operation type (Query vs Scan). In a telemetry-heavy fleet, Scan counts should be visibly lower and less frequent than Query counts. Both series will trend upward as the fleet grows.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Query"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ReturnedItemCount:Query'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Scan"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ReturnedItemCount:Scan'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Returned Item Count by Operation (mean across trials)

panels.description: Peak replication latency (ms) per destination region per window, averaged across trials. Values are sub-second because the raw sampled lag is preserved before tick-flooring — e.g., a 0.35-tick lag appears as 350 ms, not 0 ms.

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:us-east-1:ReplicationLatencyMs' then "value" end) as "us-east-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:eu-west-1:ReplicationLatencyMs' then "value" end) as "eu-west-1",
  avg(case when metric = 'Region:ap-southeast-1:ReplicationLatencyMs' then "value" end) as "ap-southeast-1"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric in (
    'Region:us-east-1:ReplicationLatencyMs',
    'Region:eu-west-1:ReplicationLatencyMs',
    'Region:ap-southeast-1:ReplicationLatencyMs'
  )
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: PutItem Latency Percentiles (ms, mean across trials)

panels.description: Per-region DynamoDB cost breakdown: WCU cost, rWCU cost, and cross-region transfer cost (multi-region only). Reveals which regions and cost components dominate total spending.

targets.rawSql:
select
  split_part(metric, ':', 2) as "Region",
  avg(case when metric like 'Region:%:TotalWriteCapacityCost' then "value" end) as "WCU Cost",
  avg(case when metric like 'Region:%:TotalReplicatedWriteCapacityCost' then "value" end) as "rWCU Cost",
  avg(case when metric like 'Region:%:TotalTransferCost' then "value" end) as "Transfer Cost"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_summary
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and (metric like 'Region:%:TotalWriteCapacityCost'
    or metric like 'Region:%:TotalReplicatedWriteCapacityCost'
    or metric like 'Region:%:TotalTransferCost')
group by split_part(metric, ':', 2)
order by split_part(metric, ':', 2);

panels.title: Per-Region Cost Breakdown: WCU / rWCU / Transfer (mean across trials)

panels.description: System error count per time window (mean across trials). Modelled on SuccessfulRequestLatency and SystemErrors metrics from DynamoDB CloudWatch.

list.definition: with stats as ( select max(case when statistic = 'mean' then "value" end) as mean_value, max(case when statistic = 'stddev' then "value" end) as stddev_value from stochastacy_demo.aggregate_summary where batch_id = '${batch_id}' and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}' and metric = 'TotalEstimatedCost' ) select concat(to_char(mean_value, 'FM$0.00000'), ' +/- ', to_char(stddev_value, 'FM$0.00000')) __text, concat(to_char(mean_value, 'FM$0.00000'), ' +/- ', to_char(stddev_value, 'FM$0.00000')) __value from stats
